thread:
Zara: Quick ask — need a lightweight onboarding bench for coyote-4b-lite before we push to canary. Target 95p latency <120ms at seq=512, batch=4; also measure throughput at batch=16. Can someone run profiling and post alloc/bandwidth numbers? I'll attach the prompt set. cc @Marco

Marco: I can run a smoke tonight. Which flavor — fp16 or q4 int8?

Zara: prefer q4_0 int8 and fp16 baseline. Focus on seq=512 tests. Please record warm vs cold KV cache.

Evan: Perf harness command to use:
```
./run_bench --model=coyote-4b-lite:q4 --seq=512 --batch=4 --warm_cache --traces=alloc,ipc --out=artifacts/coyote-lite.json
```

Marco: ACK. Kicking off on cedar-1g. ETA ~30m :zap:

Priyanka: Please capture 99p tail latency and mem_peak, and include logs for kernel selection. If >15% perf delta vs heron-6b baseline, flag it.

Marco: FYI saw kernel fallback warning on initial run. Snippet:
```
WARN kernel: fallback to generic_gemm for layer 6
```

bench-bot: Job 482991 queued on cedar-1g

ci-bot: perf-harness finished: artifacts uploaded -> https://artifacts.redwood/coyote-lite/482991

Marco: Results summary: 95p=115ms (batch=4), 99p=190ms, throughput(batch=16)=210 tok/s, mem_peak=7.8GB. q4 int8 ~1.1x faster vs fp16. Full JSON uploaded.

Zara: Can you paste the top-line numbers and link? Also compare vs orion-8b baseline.

Marco: Top-line above. Regression vs orion-8b: 95p +8%, but cost/token lower. Full artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/coyote-lite/482991/results.json :eyes:

Priyanka: Looks acceptable for canary. Propose canary at 10% traffic; monitor eval set for quality. Add canary ticket and rollback thresholds.

Zara: Creating ticket now. Rollout criteria: 95p <130ms, no accuracy regression on eval, cost_adj <1.2x. Tagging infra for capacity.

Evan: Note — quantized weights may need kernel tuning. File perf-tune issue if fallback recurs.

Marco: Reran with kernel_hint=prefer_avx to test. bench-bot started rerun 482992.

bench-bot: rerun job 482992 started with kernel_hint=prefer_avx

Marco: Rerun 482992 results: 95p=112ms, 99p=182ms, fallback gone. mem_peak ~7.8GB.

Zara: Perfect. Thanks all. Closing loop after ticket is up. :white_check_mark:
